definitions.explanation: Ridiculous statements that make no sense, as if spoken while dreaming. Often used dismissively.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、よく{寝言|ねごと}を{言|い}っていた。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often talked in my sleep.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{寝言|ねごと}で{何|なに}かつぶやいていた。
examples.english: He was muttering something in his sleep.

examples.japanese: {寝言|ねごと}を{言|い}うな。そんなことできるわけがない。
examples.english: Don't talk nonsense. There's no way that's possible.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{寝|ね} (sleep) + {言|ごと/こと} (words)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{寝言|ねごと}を{言|い}う - to talk in one's sleep; to talk nonsense
・{寝言|ねごと}を{言|い}うな - don't talk nonsense (dismissive)
・{寝言|ねごと}は{寝|ね}て{言|い}え - say your nonsense while sleeping (idiom meaning "stop talking nonsense")

RELATED 〜{言|ごと} WORDS:
・たわ{言|ごと} - nonsense, drivel
・{繰|く}り{言|ごと} - repetitive complaints
・{独|ひと}り{言|ごと} - talking to oneself

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral. The dismissive usage (sense 2) is informal.
